dimensions.summary: Main keeps all Source paths and receipts private; Reader and Activity receive bounded pathless controls, while cancel, stale and failed results retain the current safe surface and focus.
Source and Job owners, schemas, IPC, renderer and direct tests agree on reference-original preservation, managed-copy reproof, stable identifiers and reversible Operations.
PIGE-VAULT-004 and PIGE-JOB-002 gain exact service, guard, IPC and UI evidence while remaining partial for their broader durable lifecycle and recovery coverage.
One bounded Source lifecycle owner reuses Notes, Jobs, Operation and Activity composition without altering capture, parser, OCR, backup or external-root authority.
Existing Source and Job owner documents and the trace manifest record the lifecycle without adding a design document or duplicating durable rules.
